notes.title: Demo is now available
notes.notes: [p]I've done it. It's out there. For you, to play and enjoy. My horse racing roguelike card drafting game.[/p][previewyoutube="47nUr2vnIQo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And it works on SteamDeck, as the above video shows. Wow! Just wow![/p][p][/p][p][b]What does the demo offers?[/b][/p][p]Racing with 3 or 4 horses, about 50 charms that modify the game mechanics, and unlimited number of races. If you opt-in for telemetry, I will be able to analyze the data and further improve the game, but that's optional - and all data is always anonymous! You can in fact see the code for it on [url="https://github.com/hrkm/GodotCSharp_AnonymousFirestore"]GitHub [/url]if you are a programmer or fellow indie game developer.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the game, and I'm always open to feedback and suggestions for it. And if you find any bugs, please also don't hesitate to reach out through the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3735080/discussions/0/594028416743869388/"]Discussions hub[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Mateusz[/p]
